name: Koda 0.3
body:
Koda 0.3 brings AutoMix, a Mac app rebuilt the way Apple builds its own, immersive full-screen video on the Mac again, and your account's own recommendations back on Home.

**Download:** `Koda.ipa` for iPhone (iOS 26+) and `Koda.dmg` for Mac (macOS 26+, Apple silicon and Intel) are attached below. See the [README](https://github.com/Ivorisnoob/iKoda#installing) for installing.

## AutoMix

Songs flow into each other the way a DJ would mix them. Choose **AutoMix** under Settings > Song Transitions (AutoMix, Crossfade, Off), or turn it on from the queue.

- Every song is listened to once: where its music starts and ends, how it ends (fade, hard stop or ring-out), its intro, tempo and beats
- Each handover is planned from that: a **beat-matched blend** with the bass handed over mid-way, riding the song's own fade, a filtered ring-out, or a short blend on a hard stop
- **Album tracks** played in order stay gapless
- Songs **keep their endings**: soft final sections are never cut short
- A hard stop into a very different tempo comes in on the beat, never as a sudden cut
- A badge under the scrubber and the covers dissolving into each other show a mix as it happens

## The Mac

- **One sidebar, no modes.** Music, Library, Your Playlists, Videos, Channels and Explore live in one sidebar, each group folding away and remembered. Where you are decides what search finds
- **Search** heads the sidebar, as in Music and Mail
- **Lyrics and Up Next beside the page.** The player bar's buttons open a side panel, one at a time, switched at its top; the page you're on stays put. The cover still opens Now Playing
- The **player bar** is always there while something plays, on every page
- **Full-screen video** is just the picture again, in a window and Space of its own, while Koda in full screen keeps its back button, search and sidebar. **Esc** leaves it
- New shortcuts: **Videos** (Command-3) and **Watch History** (Command-4)
- The window grows past 1180x820 and works at its smallest size
- In a narrow window the speaker opens a **volume slider**

## Also new

- Mini player covers are rounded to match their bar, on iPhone and Mac
- **Video Mode** is off until you turn it on (Settings > Videos), so Koda opens as a music app

## Fixes

- **Signed in, Quick picks come from your YouTube Music account again.** YouTube started sending Home a few shelves at a time, with Quick picks further down, and Koda had been showing a radio of your last song instead
- Japanese and Chinese lyrics wrap in narrow spaces instead of running off the edge
- Only the line being sung is lit in the lyrics side panel, and tapping a line no longer flashes it before it fills from its first word
- Clicks on the Mac player bar no longer reach the page behind it
- With Bluetooth headphones, the iPhone's volume bar changes the phone's volume again
- A song on repeat one restarts the Lock Screen's clock on each loop
- A song could go silent after an AutoMix blend on iOS 27 while still showing as playing
